description: Self-hosted, multi-tenant Model Context Protocol server for the Meta Marketing API: 142 ads_* and whatsapp_* tools with OAuth 2.1, encrypted per-tenant credentials, Ad Library competitor research, video keyframes and inline MP4 delivery, Gemini video analysis, a one-call ad dossier and four agent skills published as MCP resources and prompts.
rules: Every tool is named ads_* or whatsapp_*; there is no meta_ prefix since v3.0.0, and ad_set is spelled with an underscore.
A tool whose description starts with a warning sign changes live ads, spends the advertiser's money or touches stored credentials; confirm with the user before calling one.

To look at a video ad, pick delivery by what the calling model can ingest: ads_get_video_media delivery=frames for image-capable models, delivery=inline (up to 20 MiB per video over HTTP, 6 MiB for the whole result over stdio) only for video-capable ones. Claude Code and Claude Desktop connect over stdio, so use frames there.

ads_analyze_video has the server watch the video with Gemini using the tenant's own key and costs the advertiser about 0.02 USD per call; an identical repeat within 30 minutes is served from cache and not billed.

ads_library_* tools scrape the public Meta Ad Library through the tenant's own Apify account, about 0.75 USD per 1,000 ads. Re-reading an existing dataset is free; calling ads_library_scrape again with the same arguments starts a second run and bills again, so list runs and reuse a dataset first.
Ad account ids take the act_ prefix; campaign, ad set, ad, creative and video ids are numeric strings. The tools validate the shape and return the Meta error message on the rest.
Self-hosting needs Node.js 22.13 or later; ffmpeg is optional and only needed for keyframes and compact transcodes, and the Docker image includes both.
